about.title: From low-level systems to shipped products.
paragraphs: I am a Full Stack Software Engineer in Rio de Janeiro focused on building software with strong foundations, from Rust terminal rendering pipelines and Model Context Protocol (MCP) developer tools to resilient REST APIs and responsive web interfaces.
At Salto Consulting, I also bring an integrated business and project management perspective, connecting technical architecture with measurable real-world delivery.

description: Active participation in strategic projects with an integrated view of operations
Structuring flows for client acquisition and monitoring
Initiatives for organizational culture and defining corporate values
Creation of marketing campaigns and audience analysis
Development of project management and consulting skills
Support in internal engagement processes and organizational culture
Developed an automation solution in Python using Pandas and Selenium
Reduced time spent on repetitive tasks by 40%

items.title: Black Hole ASCII Simulation
items.subtitle: 4D Kerr-Schild Geodesic Raymarching in Rust
items.description: Real-time relativistic black hole simulator rendered directly in the terminal in pure Rust with 24-bit TrueColor and Half-Block mode, integrating null geodesics via RK4, Doppler beaming, and Hawking evaporation.

items.title: Solar System ASCII
items.subtitle: 3D Keplerian Orbital Simulator in Rust
items.description: 3D terminal Solar System simulator built in pure Rust featuring Keplerian orbital mechanics, procedural raymarching, Rayon parallelism, and high-definition Half-Block/ASCII rendering.

items.title: ABNT MCP
items.subtitle: Academic Research Copilot via Model Context Protocol
items.description: MCP server for scientific research and ABNT-compliant academic writing, featuring normative auditing, Crossref/SciELO source lookup, citation validation, and PDF compilation via Typst and LaTeX.

items.title: Memcard
items.subtitle: Zero-Loss Emulator Save Versioning
items.description: Cross-platform desktop application for zero-loss game save synchronization and versioning across retro emulators (DuckStation, PCSX2, RetroArch, RPCS3) and PC ports, built with Tauri, Rust, and React 19.

items.title: Scheduling System API
items.subtitle: Production-Oriented RESTful Architecture
items.description: Appointment scheduling API built with ASP.NET Core 9 and Entity Framework Core featuring JWT authentication, role-based access control (Admin/Client), PostgreSQL, Docker, and Swagger UI.

items.title: FURIA CS2 FanBot
items.subtitle: Full-Stack Experience & Conversational Bot
items.description: Full-stack fan platform integrating a Python Telegram bot, cached Fastify.js REST API, and responsive Next.js landing page orchestrated with Docker Compose.
